THE ASSURANCE GUARANTEE

Built to Last,

the First Time

Here at Assurance Roofing & Exteriors, we pride ourselves on our commitment to providing top-tier roofing and exterior services. Our team comprises industry veterans who bring years of experience and knowledge to the table.

 

We are driven by a singular mission - providing you with the assurance of a safe, secure, and attractive property.

EXPERIENCE

ACCOUNTABILITY

Over the years, we have worked on countless residential and commercial projects, honing our skills and expanding our knowledge. Our hands-on experience has equipped us with the expertise to handle different kinds of projects, no matter how complex. Working with Assurance means entrusting your property to seasoned professionals who know the ins and outs of the industry.

We understand that as a property owner, you want a reliable, trustworthy team that can deliver results without compromise. That's why we operate with the highest level of accountability. From the initial consultation to the completion of the project, we ensure open, honest communication and a smooth, hassle-free process. We take responsibility for all our actions, giving you peace of mind and confidence in our services.

OUR SERVICES

We Offer a Range of Exterior Services to Meet All Types of Needs

ALL SERVICES

RESIDENTIAL ROOFING

Your home is your sanctuary and it deserves the best. Our residential roofing services include everything from installing a new roof to repairing or replacing an existing one. We use the highest quality materials and tailor our services to suit your specific needs and budget, providing you with a roof that not only looks great but also serves its purpose effectively for years to come.

COMMERCIAL ROOFING

We provide comprehensive roofing solutions to businesses across Kansas. Our services range from roof installation to maintenance and repair. We understand the unique challenges that commercial properties represent and we have the skills and experience to ensure your commercial roof meets the highest standards of quality and durability.

SIDING

Siding is more than just an aesthetic feature—it's your home's first line of defense against the elements. We offer a variety of siding options to suit every style and budget, all installed by our team of trained professionals. Our siding solutions not only enhance the curb appeal of your home but also help in improving its insulation and reducing energy costs.

STORM RESTORATION

When storms strike, the damage can be devastating. Our team is experienced in storm restoration services and can help you repair any kind of storm damage to your roof. We also assist with filing insurance claims and obtaining compensation for damages.
